status: released: @fiestaboard/ui 7.4.0 (tag v7.4.0, 6c16021e; #338 squashed as 5a4a4655). Every file is byte-identical to its blob at the tag except plugin-models.json, which keeps #336 (22db0b5) until 8.0.0; re-vendor with scripts/fiestaui_fixtures/vendor.sh and bump these hashes in the same PR
note: Every file is byte-identical to its blob at `commit`, except where `files_from` names another commit. #338 changed device-model.schema.json (optional layoutOptions, LED only), device-models.json (every built-in LED model allows both tileGap values and both blockPadding values, with today's defaults) and led-golden.json (14 layout cases and one flip case for the two options, design spec section 7.6). #338 branched from main before #336, so plugin-models.json stays at 22db0b5 (#336: FiestaPanel split-flap streams at 0.5 fps); every other file is identical at both commits. Before #338: Every file is byte-identical to its blob at the commit. The batch changed device-models.json (Vestaboard flagship/note/note_array stream at 1 fps, panel at 0.5 fps; the Pixoo 64 streams at 2 fps and snaps), led-golden.json (the flip budget keeps the scramble and shortens the stagger first; the 32-frame budget cases run on an inlined generic sequence device, sequence_panel_64) and charset-golden.json (kiosk_mono_v1 and five supported-icon cases). device-models.json and charset-golden.json are unchanged since cb500a8 (#326), led-golden.json since ff8186e (#328); everything else is unchanged since 95423b31c1446bfc6c6d7f62b901cbb16c21d147.
